title: Neon Cyber Portrait
description: A person with short dark hair crouches dynamically in the center of a vibrant, futuristic studio filled with glowing neon rings and colorful geometric patterns. They wear a stylized cyberpunk outfit with a purple patterned jacket, glowing blue circular accents, turquoise pants with floral motifs, and glowing pink platform boots, surrounded by large pink peonies on a reflective floor.
